a.text: I'll honor our agreement: operate until the reserve hits 8, then take 4 each. The storm risk is high, so let's both operate every round and take the moment the reserve reaches 8. I won't take early.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating now. Once the reserve reaches 8, we each take 4.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Operating again. That should bring the reserve to 8. Next round we each take 4, unless a leak keeps it below 8, in which case I'll keep operating.

b.text: Next round I take my 4 if the reserve is at 8.
